class.name: ShapeQuery3DDirect
class.brief_description: A query for a specific shape, at some transform in space.
class.description: [admonition type="note" collapsible="true" open="false"] [b]Part of [i]Godot Engine: Conservatory Edition[/i].[/b] This is not available in the official build of Godot. [/admonition] This class queries for physics bodies and areas intersecting a shape at some transform in space.

method.name: query
method.description: Performs a query using the properties of this object as parameters. Can return up to [param max_count] items.

method.name: query_statically
method.description: Statically perform a query using the provided [param parameters]. Can return up to [param max_count] items.

method.name: query_statically_preallocated
method.description: Statically perform a query using the provided [param parameters]. This variation of the method is special in that it expects the passed array ([param result_preallocated]) to have its size set [b]before[/b] calling this method. The size of this array is used to determine the number of results. This variation of the method is most optimal, as any instances of results in the array will be overwritten, instead of an entirely new result object being created. The array passed in is obviously edited; it is your result array.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], collisions with physics areas (like [Area3D]) will be reported.
If [code]true[/code], collisions with physics bodies (like [PhysicsBody3D]) will be reported.

The query's collision mask. Only objects in at least one collision layer enabled in the mask will be detected. See [url=$DOCS_URL/tutorials/physics/physics_introduction.html#collision-layers-and-masks]Collision layers and masks[/url] in the documentation for more information.
The location of the shape in space. Note that scaling this transform is not advised; prefer setting the size properties of the shape.
The RID of the [Shape3D] that is being used for the test.
The brim added to the outside of the shape, which gives it additional thickness.
The RIDs in this array will be excluded from the query and cannot be hit.
